A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work. All pages, equations, 13 figures, and Appendices A–D are available and readable; the revised layout does not prevent reliable comparison.

before.justification: V2 reports original numerical experiments on parameter learning, function-space generalization, noise, Green’s-function extraction, and grid-size sensitivity, including repeated-run results in Appendix C.

after.justification: V3 retains these original numerical experiments and their results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The model architectures, learning losses, cross-validation procedure, and one-hot-input Green’s-function extraction remain unchanged. Corrections to gradient equations in Appendix A.3 repair the proof rather than introduce a different proposed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same polynomial, sine, cosine, and piecewise-linear function spaces, with 1D Poisson, 1D biharmonic, and 2D Poisson problems. Noise and grid-variation scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: The corresponding experiments retain finite-difference, linear, deep-linear, MLP, PINN, DeepONet, FNO, and PI-DeepONet models. Newly cited DINO, ReNO, and RINO are discussed as related work and are not added experimental comparators.

E3.justification: Both retain 25 datasets, 10,000 examples per dataset configuration, unit-norm solution normalization, the Ngrid = 22 cross-evaluation, and Appendix B’s training settings. V3’s new training-MSE-floor description is a mathematical interpretation, not a documented change to evaluation.

E4.justification: Noise testing, Green’s-function inspection, and grid/stencil sensitivity analyses retain the same evidence in Figures 7 and 9–13 and Appendices B–D. The expanded explanations introduce no additional robustness tests or ablations.

E5.justification: Both select heatmap rows using the best training MSE from five runs and report five-run means with min–max spreads in Figure 3 and Appendix C/Figure 11. No uncertainty-reporting practice or run count changes.

E6.justification: The plotted results are unchanged. However, v3 Section 4.1 strengthens v2’s qualitative agreement statement to nearly machine-precision agreement between low-degree linear-model predictions and observations. This is a changed reported finding without new numerical evidence; Figure 2 does not establish that precision.

T1.justification: Appendix A.3 corrects gradient signs in Equations 38–39, the update sign in Equation 41, coefficient dimensions, SVD/nullspace algebra, and the decay factor from 1−eta to 1−eta D². The theorem statements remain unchanged. Section 4.1 also newly identifies a squared operator-projection residual as a training-MSE floor, an identification inconsistent with Equations 10–11.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same substantive claims about function-space-dependent generalization, contrasting model behavior, Green’s-function interpretability, and cross-set validation. Revised framing makes these claims more explicit without changing their central scope.

C2.justification: New Section 6 explicitly limits the theory and empirical validation to linear PDE settings and states that no remedy is proposed. Section 4.1 adds conditioning and truncation-error explanations; Figure 3 and the PINN discussion newly attribute its behavior to the finite-difference mechanism, beyond v2’s observation of similar trends.

D1.justification: Section 3.1 newly states that u is obtained by analytical differentiation, while the compressed PINN discussion omits v2’s explicit single-solution-instance description. These change the documentation without establishing an actual procedural change. Appendix B’s libraries, hardware, precision, and hyperparameters are retained.

R1.justification: V3 adds DINO, ReNO, and RINO citations, connects its visualization to mechanistic interpretability, and distinguishes function-space generalization from resolution-independent operator learning. Neural Operator and other publication-reference updates represent the same earlier works.

P1.justification: V3 substantially revises the introductory framing and theory-to-experiment narrative, expands Section 4.1 into model-specific explanations, and folds the former standalone PINN subsection into it. It also adds a Limitations section, replaces placeholder acknowledgments, and edits language throughout the manuscript.

P2.justification: The main text and references change from a single-column preprint layout to a two-column proceedings layout, with widespread figure resizing and relocation. Figures 4–5 now share a page, and Figures 9–10 appear together after the conclusion. All 13 figures retain their graphical content; Figure 3’s caption gains interpretation.

improvement.justification: V3 improves proof consistency through Appendix A.3’s corrections and clarifies scope through the new limitations and related-work discussion. However, Section 4.1 newly conflates operator-projection error with training MSE: Equations 10–11 imply zero residual on the training subspace, while Figure 2 measures relative operator error. Its stronger precision and PINN-mechanism assertions also lack additional supporting evidence. These benefits coexist with inaccuracies affecting the central generalization explanation, leaving the net quality direction uncertain.
